အဖြေရှင်းလင်းချက်:

Step 1: Split the integral based on the sign of sin 2x

sin 2x ≥ 0 on [0, π/2] and sin 2x ≤ 0 on [π/2, π]

₀^π |sin 2x| dx = ∫₀^(π/2) sin 2x dx - ∫_(π/2)^π sin 2x dx

Step 2: Evaluate each integral

= [-½ cos 2x]₀^(π/2) - [-½ cos 2x]_(π/2)^π

= (-½(-1) - (-½(1))) - (-½(1) - (-½(-1)))

= (½ + ½) - (-½ - ½) = 1 - (-1) = 2

အဖြေ: 2

Find the area of the region bounded by the curve y = x³ - 4x² + 3x and the x-axis.
Find the area contained between the line y = 2x and the curve y = x²
c:
အဖြေရှင်းလင်းချက်:

Step 1: Find intersection points

x² = 2x
x² - 2x = 0
x(x - 2) = 0
x = 0, 2

Step 2: Set up area integral

Area = ∫₀² (2x - x²) dx

Step 3: Evaluate

= [x² - x³/3]₀² = (4 - 8/3) - 0 = 4/3

အဖြေ: 4/3

q: Find the volume of revolution formed when the curve f(x) = √(sin x) for 0 ≤ x ≤ π/2 is rotated through 360° about the x-axis
c:
အဖြေရှင်းလင်းချက်:

Step 1: Set up volume integral (disc method)

V = π ∫₀^(π/2) [f(x)]² dx = π ∫₀^(π/2) (√(sin x))² dx

Step 2: Simplify and evaluate

V = π ∫₀^(π/2) sin x dx = π[-cos x]₀^(π/2)
= π(-cos(π/2) + cos 0) = π(0 + 1) = π

အဖြေ: π

c:
အဖြေရှင်းလင်းချက်:

Step 1: Find antiderivative

∫(-3x + 2) dx = -3x²/2 + 2x

Step 2: Evaluate at limits

= [-3x²/2 + 2x]₀^(2/3)
= (-3/2(4/9) + 2(2/3)) - 0
= -2/3 + 4/3 = 2/3

အဖြေ: 2/3

q: Find the area contained between the line y = x and the curve y = x²
c:
အဖြေရှင်းလင်းချက်:

Step 1: Find intersection points

x = x²
x² - x = 0
x(x - 1) = 0
x = 0, 1

Step 2: Set up area integral

Area = ∫₀¹ (x - x²) dx

Step 3: Evaluate

= [x²/2 - x³/3]₀¹ = (1/2 - 1/3) - 0 = 1/6

အဖြေ: 1/6
